members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A part that survives a data change keeps its segment and slides to its new share.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name in the legend and the tooltip.

members.name: value
members.doc: Size of the part. Shares are worked out against the sum of the parts on show.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Parts default to the shared --series-* palette in data order, then neutral steps.

types.name: CompositionChartProps
types.doc: Use a composition chart for the parts of one whole, when their shares matter more than their history.

members.name: data
members.doc: The parts, in the order they should sit in the bar and the legend.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the whole is, such as "Cloud spend by service". Names the chart for assistive technology and heads the readout.

members.name: totalLabel
members.doc: Short text beside the total, such as "total in November".

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats the total and each part's value.

members.name: barHeight
members.doc: Height of the bar in pixels.

members.name: hideHeader
members.doc: Hides the headline with the total.

members.name: hiddenKeys
members.doc: Controlled keys of the parts switched off in the legend. The rest are rescaled to fill the bar.

members.name: defaultHiddenKeys
members.doc: Parts switched off on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onHiddenChange
members.doc: Called when a legend item switches a part on or off. The last part on show cannot be switched off.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
